method_note: FAST MODE. Platform facts from each platform's own official pages only, read live 26 Nov 2026. Prices verbatim in original currency. Brand facts from live weddedwonderland.com only.

facts.claim: Paperless Post pay-per-event pricing uses Coins: multiply the design's Coin cost by the number of recipients. Paperless Post Plus (200 Coins) unlocks extra customisation and guest management tools. Sample calculator shows 3 Coins = $1.44 (USD).
facts.quote: Choose our flexible pay per event plan, where you can add design elements and management features a la carte. Multiply your invitation's Coin cost by the number of recipients for your total send cost. ... Paperless Post Plus 200 coins Unlock more of our customization and guest management tools when you add any Plus feature during the creation process. Great for professional events, weddings, and more. ... Total Coins to send 3 Coins $1.44
facts.publisher: Paperless Post (official pricing page)
facts.use_note: USD (US$ implied; page shows $ with no currency label; US company). Page also carries a time-limited promo (20% off Coins, code ends 12/1); do not quote the promo.

facts.claim: Paperless Post says it also has many free designs; a Paperless Pro subscription is priced by annual guest count, shown at $250/year for 250 annual guests (USD).
facts.quote: Paperless Post also has many free invitations and greeting card designs for you to customize and send. ... Try the Paperless Pro subscription, which includes unlimited access to all our features and simple, transparent pricing (no Coins). Plans are based on annual guest count ... Annual guests 250 ... $250/year
facts.publisher: Paperless Post (official pricing page)
facts.use_note: Subscription is pitched at professionals and 3+ events a year; not the obvious pick for one wedding.

facts.claim: Greenvelope sends digital invitations and cards with an animated envelope, liner, stamp and music, by email or text (in supported countries), with built-in RSVP tracking and guest list management; guests need no account; flat one-time price by guest count from $19 (USD), no subscription; ad-free.
facts.quote: Greenvelope digital invitations arrive with a signature animated envelope opening, a personalized liner, a stamp, and background music that sets the tone before guests read a word. Upload your own design or customize a designer suite, then send by email or text message (in supported countries) with built-in RSVP tracking and guest list management. Guests never need an account to reply. Pricing is a flat one-time amount set by guest count, starting at $19, with no subscription required.
facts.publisher: Greenvelope (official pricing page)
facts.use_note: Currency shown as $ with no label; treat as USD. Text delivery is 'in supported countries': whether Australia is supported is unclear.

facts.claim: Canva plans: Free US$0/month for one person; Pro US$18/month for one person (page shows a time-limited 50% off first 3 months). Prices exclude applicable tax.
facts.quote: Free ... US$0 /month for one person ... Pro ... US$18 ... /month for one person ... Prices exclude applicable tax.
facts.publisher: Canva (official pricing page)
facts.use_note: Firecrawl may have served the US price; Canva shows local currency by region, so AUD pricing for Australians is unclear. Do not quote the 50% promo.

facts.claim: Paperless Post save the dates can be customised and shared by email, text or link; it says opens can be tracked; text (SMS) delivery is for US phone numbers only.
facts.quote: Set the tone for a seaside celebration with beach-themed save the dates. Customize and share via email, text, or link. ... Send all of our invitations and cards via text, Shareable Link, and email, too. \* SMS delivery available for US phone numbers only. [meta description:] Browse free and paid beach and tropical save the date card templates. Customize designs. Send ecards via email, text, or link. Track opens.
facts.publisher: Paperless Post (official save the dates category page)
facts.use_note: For Australian guests: SMS is US numbers only, so use email or the Shareable Link (which can be pasted into any message app). 'Track opens' appears in the page meta description, not body copy.

facts.claim: Greenvelope digital wedding save the dates: animated envelope with liner, stamp and music; send by email, text or sharable link; no guest account; address collection inside the save the date; add your wedding website link; tracks opens and responses in real time; upload your own design; daily open-rate summaries.
facts.quote: Send by email, text, or sharable link, ad-free with no guest account required and a flat one-time price by guest count. ... Address Collection Collect guest mailing addresses directly through your save the date for sending paper invitations or thank you notes. ... Your Own Design Have a more specific vision? Upload your own design and still take advantage of Greenvelope's delivery and tracking. ... Add your wedding website link, then send by email, text message, or sharable link. Greenvelope tracks opens and responses in real time and can collect mailing addresses for the invitations that follow. ... Greenvelope pairs with any wedding website builder.
facts.publisher: Greenvelope (official wedding save the dates page)
facts.use_note: Ignore the page's own '4.9 stars Trustpilot' and 'best way' marketing claims; do not repeat them.

facts.claim: Greenvelope single mailing prices (USD, as listed): up to 20 people $19; up to 100 $99; up to 160 $159; up to 200 $199; up to 250 $249. Unlimited mailings for a year: up to 150 people per mailing $225/year; up to 250 $375/year. Each person on the list counts as one (a family of four counts as four).
facts.quote: One mailing $19 one time Up to 20 people ... Up to 100 People$99 ... Up to 160 People$159 ... Up to 200 People$199 ... Up to 250 People$249 ... Up to 150 People / Mailing$225 / Year ... Up to 250 People / Mailing$375 / Year ... Each person (with or without email) added to the mailing list counts as (1) person. For example, "The Smith Family" of John, Jill, Tim, and Lauren would count as (4) people.
facts.publisher: Greenvelope (official wedding save the dates page)
facts.use_note: $ unlabelled; US company, treat as USD and say so. Prices as read 26 Nov 2026.

facts.claim: Greenvelope text delivery: every paid account includes a maximum of 500 text messages; SMS is 'in supported countries'; also WhatsApp, Facebook Messenger or sharable link.
facts.quote: Every paid Greenvelope account includes a maximum of 500 text messages. ... In addition to email, you can send your Greenvelope invitations and cards via SMS text message (in supported countries), WhatsApp, Facebook messenger, or a sharable link.
facts.publisher: Greenvelope (official wedding save the dates page)
facts.use_note: Whether Australian mobile numbers are a supported SMS country is unclear from this page.

facts.claim: Greenvelope's own timing line: most couples send save the dates 6 to 8 months before, or 8 to 12 months for a destination wedding.
facts.quote: Most couples send wedding save the dates 6 to 8 months before the wedding, or 8 to 12 months for a destination wedding so guests can book travel.
facts.publisher: Greenvelope (official wedding save the dates page)
facts.use_note: Platform opinion, not ours. Use our own timing (see WW facts) as the article's guidance; this is a cross-check only.

facts.claim: Evite offers customisable digital wedding save the dates, RSVP optional, in Free and Premium designs, including upload-your-own-design; send by email, text or shareable link; track RSVPs in real time and manage the guest list.
facts.quote: Browse Evite's collection of customizable (and RSVP optional) digital Save the Dates. ... Price Free Premium ... Upload Your Own Design (Portrait) ... we put together ... with Evite, you can send your invites by email, text or shareable link, making it easier to get the word out. You can also track RSVPs in real-time and manage your guest list all from one place
facts.publisher: Evite (official wedding save the dates page)
facts.use_note: No prices on this page. Evite Pro is described as an annual subscription for unlimited Premium invites; cost not stated here (unclear). Whether text works for Australian numbers is not stated (unclear). DROPPED from shortlist by strategist (26 Nov); kept for reference only.

facts.claim: Evite Pro is an annual subscription that allows unlimited Premium invites; page meta says you can share instantly for free.
facts.quote: Evite Pro is also a great option for anyone sending lots of invitations throughout the year. This annual subscription allows you to send an unlimited number of Premium invites! [meta description:] Customize your digital design, share instantly for free, and keep guests informed before your big day.
facts.publisher: Evite (official wedding save the dates page)
facts.use_note: 'Free' applies to Free designs; Premium design pricing not shown on this page (unclear). DROPPED from shortlist by strategist (26 Nov); kept for reference only.

facts.claim: Evite's own timing line: couples generally send save the dates 8 to 12 months before, and even earlier for destination weddings.
facts.quote: Generally, couples send out these invitations between eight and 12 months before the wedding date. However, you should send out save the date invitations even further in advance for destination weddings or holiday weddings
facts.publisher: Evite (official wedding save the dates page)
facts.use_note: Platform opinion; cross-check only. Note Evite's blog says 6 to 8 months (map snippet), so Evite is internally inconsistent. DROPPED from shortlist by strategist (26 Nov); kept for reference only.

facts.claim: Canva has free customisable save the date card templates (2,540 shown) and printed save the date cards from $9.50; it suggests sending earlier for a destination wedding.
facts.quote: Amp up the excitement for your wedding day using free, printable save the date card templates from Canva. ... Showing 50 of 2,540 ... Printable save the date cards by Canva Print from $9.50 ... If you're planning a destination wedding, consider sending it out earlier to give your guests enough time to plan.
facts.publisher: Canva (official save the date templates page)
facts.use_note: Canva is a design tool, not a send-and-track platform: this page names no email delivery, RSVP or open tracking (unclear / not offered here). Position it as 'design it, then send the image or link yourself'. $9.50 currency unlabelled (likely USD from US-served scrape).

facts.claim: Zola digital save the dates (example design 'Coastal' listed as Free): add a photo, customise background colour, collect guests' addresses, link to your wedding website; Zola creates a unique link you paste into a text, email or DM; editable after publishing; matching paper and magnet versions offered.
facts.quote: Coastal Free ... Details - Add a photo - Customize the background color - Collect guests' addresses - Link to your wedding website ... How It Works 1. Customize a digital design. 2. We'll create a unique link to access your digital save the date. 3. Copy and paste this link into a message - send through text, email, or DM! 4. Go hybrid! Some couples like to follow up with matching paper save the dates. ... you can always edit your save the date after it's published.
facts.publisher: Zola (official digital save the date product page)
facts.use_note: Delivery is link-based (you send it yourself), so no Zola-sent email is stated here; open tracking not mentioned (unclear). 'Free' shown on this design; do not claim every Zola digital design is free. DROPPED from shortlist by strategist (26 Nov); kept for reference only.

facts.claim: The Knot digital save the dates are described as completely free, fully customisable, and sent as a shareable link by email or text; they can be paired with matching paper invitations and a free wedding website.
facts.quote: On The Knot, these designs are completely free, fully customizable, and a shareable link can be sent instantly to your loved ones via email or text. ... you can pair our electronic designs with matching paper invitations and a free wedding website.
facts.publisher: The Knot (official digital save the date cards page)
facts.use_note: Page lists 86 designs incl. a 'Destination' style. Ignore the CYBER50 paper promo. Open tracking not mentioned (unclear). DROPPED from shortlist by strategist (26 Nov); kept for reference only.

facts.claim: The Knot help centre: once digital save the dates are ready you go to the Share section, copy the link and share it.
facts.quote: Once your Digital Save the Dates are ready, you'll be taken to the Share section, shown below - Just copy the link and share it with your friends and family – it's that simple!
facts.publisher: The Knot Help Center (official)
facts.use_note: Confirms link-share model; The Knot does not state it emails guests for you on this page. Help article 'Do you offer digital Save the Dates?' answers 'Absolutely!' (updated 2/2/2026). DROPPED from shortlist by strategist (26 Nov); kept for reference only.

facts.claim: Joy's pricing page says Joy is free to use ($0/mo), including wedding website, online RSVP, unlimited guests and hundreds of digital invites; optional paid upgrades include custom domains, text messaging and premium designs for digital and printed stationery.
facts.quote: Joy is free to use. $ 0 /mo ... Wedding Website ... Unlimited Guests ... Online RSVP ... Hundreds of Digital Invites ... We've also added optional upgrades, like custom domain names, text messaging, and premium designs for digital and printed stationery
facts.publisher: Joy (official pricing page)
facts.use_note: Upgrade prices not stated on this page (unclear). Firecrawl served a cached copy from 26 Nov 2026. DROPPED from shortlist by strategist (26 Nov); kept for reference only.

facts.claim: Joy Basic Digital save the dates are free; Premium Digital Cards are available in Australia among other countries. Cards can show a website link and up to two button links (e.g. RSVP or Travel page); emails can include an Add to Calendar link. Send by copy link (text, WhatsApp, social) or Joy emails personalised cards and you can track who opened them in the guest list.
facts.quote: (Premium Digital Cards are available in the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, Australia, New Zealand, Singapore, and across the EU.) ... Click the Price filter and select Free Digital to see only Basic Digital Cards. ... Toggle Display link to your website on or off ... choose up to two links to display on your card, like your RSVP page or Travel page. ... toggle Include event date and Include "Add to Calendar" link on or off. ... Share with a Link ... Click Copy Link and send it however you like, text message, WhatsApp, social media, group chat. ... Email Personalized Cards means Joy sends personalized emails on your behalf. Each card includes your guest's name, and you can track who opened it in your guest list.
facts.publisher: Joy Help Center (official)
facts.use_note: Strong fit for overseas guests: link via WhatsApp plus opens tracking on emailed cards. Map snippet shows Joy paper save the dates 'From $1.56 each' (USD, paper product, not digital). DROPPED from shortlist by strategist (26 Nov); kept for reference only.

facts.claim: Riley & Grey digital save the dates are sent by email through its Advanced Mode of Guest Management; they look like a typical email with no effects or animation; layout options Text, Upload Image, or Image + Text.
facts.quote: The digital invitations and save-the-dates are sent with our Advanced Mode of Guest Management and sent by email to wedding guests. Therefore, all digital invitations and save-the-dates will look like a typical email and do not have additional effects or animation aspects. However, you have different options for the email layout including the following: "Text," "Upload Image," "Image + Text."
facts.publisher: Riley & Grey Support (official)
facts.use_note: Help page last updated Oct 2024; may be out of date. Whether Advanced Mode needs a paid plan: see pricing fact. DROPPED from shortlist by strategist (26 Nov); kept for reference only.

facts.claim: Riley & Grey membership is $39/month or $299 for a year (USD); digital save-the-dates and invites are free with membership, sent through Guest Management with no per-invite cost.
facts.quote: Riley & Grey membership Most popular $39/month or $299for a year ... Prices are in USD. ... How much are digital save-the-dates and invites? They're free! With your Riley & Grey membership, you're able to access all of our coordinating invitation and save-the-date designs, and download to send digitally through Guest Management. ... There is no cost to send as many invitations as you'd like!
facts.publisher: Riley & Grey (official pricing page)
facts.use_note: DROPPED from shortlist by strategist (26 Nov); kept for reference only.

facts.claim: Bliss & Bone online save the dates: design for free, then pay per recipient ($1.20 each for 1-9, $0.90 each for 10+, $0.70 each for 300+; all prices USD). Fully customisable, upload art and logos or your own photo; deliver by email, text or WhatsApp with tracking and free follow-up reminders.
facts.quote: Choose from hundreds of designs or upload your own photo, then deliver by email, text, or WhatsApp with built-in tracking and free follow-up reminders. ✔️ Design for free • $0.90 per send ✔️ Fully customizable • upload art & logos ... Save the Date Online $1.20 each for 1-9 Recipients $0.90 each for 10+ $0.70 each for 300+ All prices are in USD.
facts.publisher: Bliss & Bone (official save the date online page)

facts.claim: Bliss & Bone: track opens, catch bounced addresses, free follow-up reminders; link to wedding website inside the email; optional RSVP collection; email and WhatsApp work globally, text delivery US and Canada only; designs match its invitations and wedding website.
facts.quote: From your account, you can track opens, catch bounced addresses, and send free follow-up reminders to guests who haven't responded. ... A link to your wedding website lives right inside the email. ... You can enable RSVP collection, but most couples save RSVPs for the formal invitation. ... Email delivery and WhatsApp sharing work globally with no additional cost or postage, which makes digital save the dates particularly practical for destination weddings and couples with international guest lists. Text delivery is supported in US and Canada.
facts.publisher: Bliss & Bone (official save the date online page)
facts.use_note: Key line for Australian couples: no SMS to Australian numbers; use email or WhatsApp.

facts.claim: Bliss & Bone timing line: 6 to 8 months for most, 8 to 12 months for destination weddings; for destination weddings factor in passport renewals and a 12-month notice is not excessive.
facts.quote: Send digital save the dates 6 to 8 months before the wedding for most guests, and 8 to 12 months out for destination weddings or events over holiday weekends. ... For destination weddings, factor in passport renewals, international flights, and time-off planning. A 12-month notice isn't excessive.
facts.publisher: Bliss & Bone (official save the date online page)
facts.use_note: Platform opinion, cross-check only.

facts.claim: Greetings Island has 718 save the date designs (free and Premium); download image or PDF, print at home, share online, or order prints; send as an email or share via SMS, WhatsApp and Facebook; Premium membership is 'a low monthly price' for 5000+ premium designs, fonts, stickers and no ads.
facts.quote: Download image or PDF - Print at home - Share online - Order prints ... 718 designs ... Personalize your favorite digital card with your details, and you're ready to send your completed project as an email or download the image or PDF. ... Or share it online via SMS, WhatsApp & Facebook. ... For a low monthly price, you can have access to over 5000 premium designs, and you also open up all premium fonts and stickers. An extra bonus is that the entire experience is ad free.
facts.publisher: Greetings Island (official save the date page)
facts.use_note: Premium price not stated on this page (unclear). Free tier implies ads. RSVP is offered on its invitations; whether save the dates track opens is not stated (unclear). Its own timing line '4 to 6 months, add another month for destination' conflicts with our guidance; do not use.

facts.claim: Etsy is a marketplace of independent sellers. Its help centre says digital purchases are either instant downloads (ready-made files available once payment is confirmed) or made-to-order downloads (the seller makes them to your specifications and sends the files); files download from Purchases on a browser, not the Etsy app; digital listings cannot be returned or cancelled, though Purchase Protection may apply if an item is not as described or never delivered.
facts.quote: There are 2 kinds of digital purchases: Instant downloads: Ready-made files that are available once your payment is confirmed. ... Made-to-order downloads: Digital items that the seller will make to your specifications after you purchase them. The seller will send your files to you once they have completed them. ... You can't download a digital purchase through the Etsy app at this time. ... digital listings are not able to be returned or canceled. If there's a problem with your digital order, like it's not as described in the listing or the seller never delivers the file, you may be covered under Etsy's Purchase Protection.
facts.publisher: Etsy Help (official)
facts.use_note: Describe Etsy as a marketplace: features vary by seller, so no platform-level sending, RSVP or open tracking (couple sends the file themselves). No prices: listing prices are set by sellers. Firecrawl served a cached copy dated 25 Nov 2026.

facts.claim: Zazzle digital save the dates: customise templates or start from scratch, download as JPG, PNG or PDF; after purchase you get an email link to the editable template; sent by the couple via email, SMS or social media. Most listed designs show Price $11.95 (USD on zazzle.com).
facts.quote: Digital save the dates are evites that are commonly sent via email, SMS, or social media platforms. ... Create your own digital save the dates by using existing templates or starting from scratch. You can personalize the card with details to match your own important information and then download it as JPG, PNG or PDF. After purchasing, you will receive an email with a link to access the editable template that you can customize and download. ... Price$11.95
facts.publisher: Zazzle (official digital save the dates page)
facts.use_note: US site prices (USD). Zazzle runs an Australian site (zazzle.com.au) not checked: AUD price unclear. Many designs are by independent creators. No RSVP or open tracking stated (download-and-send product).

facts.claim: Wonderland Studio is free: guest list and RSVPs, budget, seating, a wedding website and seven more tools; no credit card, no trial clock.
facts.quote: Guest list and RSVPs, budget, seating, your wedding website and seven more tools, guided by luxury wedding experts. ... Free to use · no credit card · no trial clock
facts.publisher: Wedded Wonderland (Wonderland Studio page)

facts.claim: Studio RSVPs: replies, plus-ones and dietary notes arrive straight into the guest list; wedding website in minutes with six templates rooted in wedding traditions, each with RSVP built in.
facts.quote: Every RSVP, the moment it lands Replies, plus-ones and dietary notes arrive straight into your guest list. ... Your wedding website, in minutes Six templates rooted in wedding traditions, each with RSVP built in.
facts.publisher: Wedded Wonderland (Wonderland Studio page)
facts.use_note: Templates: Marigold & Gold (South Asian), Emerald & Oud (Middle Eastern), Double Happiness (East Asian), Coastal Editorial (Mediterranean), Heritage & Bloom (African), Modern Classic (Western).

facts.claim: Studio's checklist includes 'Send save-the-dates' as a task; there is no save-the-date design or sending tool listed among the tools on the live page.
facts.quote: A checklist that keeps up Month-by-month tasks, so nothing slips as the day gets closer. This month0% - Book the venue - Send save-the-dates - Shortlist photographers - Order the invitations - Choose the menu
facts.publisher: Wedded Wonderland (Wonderland Studio page)
facts.use_note: Do NOT say Studio makes or sends save the dates. Position: send the save the date from a platform below, with your Studio website link on it. Coordinator confirmed no save-the-date maker.

facts.claim: Studio pricing FAQ: the planning suite is free with all 11 tools; free accounts hold a generous guest list; optional paid extras priced separately when they launch.
facts.quote: How much does Wonderland Studio cost? Nothing. The planning suite is free: create an account and all 11 tools are yours, with no credit card and no trial clock. Optional paid extras will be priced separately when they launch, and you will never be charged without choosing one. ... Free accounts can hold a generous guest list
facts.publisher: Wedded Wonderland (Wonderland Studio page)
facts.use_note: CONFLICT: /expert-advice/wedding-rsvp (map snippet) says free RSVP and guest list tools work 'for up to 50 guests'; the Studio page says 'a generous guest list' with no number. Avoid stating a guest cap; flag to Nic.

facts.claim: Our timing: send save the dates 9 to 12 months ahead once any guest travels or the date falls in peak season, and about six months ahead otherwise.
facts.quote: Send save the dates 9 to 12 months ahead once any guest travels or the date falls in peak season, and about six months ahead otherwise.
facts.publisher: Wedded Wonderland (When to Send Wedding Invitations and Each Deadline)
facts.use_note: Primary timing line for the article. Page H1 on 26 Nov 2026 reads 'When to Send Wedding Invitations and Each Deadline'.

facts.claim: Destination weddings: save the dates 9 to 12 months out, invitations 4 to 6 months out, reply-by date 10 to 12 weeks before; overseas guests get theirs first.
facts.quote: Send save the dates 9 to 12 months out, post invitations 4 to 6 months out and set the reply-by date 10 to 12 weeks before the day. ... When do overseas guests get a save the date? Nine to 12 months before the wedding, and before they book annual leave or fares. Send theirs first, with a note saying why you are writing early, then tell close family at home in person. Guests who need a visa also need the date, venue and accommodation in writing before the six-month mark.
facts.publisher: Wedded Wonderland (When to Send Wedding Invitations and Each Deadline)

facts.claim: Save the date rules: wait for the countersigned venue contract; send only to guests you are certain to invite; have the wedding website live first since the card points to it; with under about four months to go, skip the save the date and send the invitation; when behind, a digital invitation within a fortnight is suggested.
facts.quote: Wait for the countersigned venue contract. - Send one only to guests you are certain to invite, since it promises an invitation. ... - Have the wedding website live first, since the card points to it. ... With under about four months to go, skip the save the date and send the invitation. ... Send a digital invitation within a fortnight, designed by your stationer, with the reply-by date.
facts.publisher: Wedded Wonderland (When to Send Wedding Invitations and Each Deadline)
facts.use_note: Ties to Studio: build the Studio website first, put its link on the digital save the date.

facts.claim: Tools page FAQ: launch the website when save-the-dates go out.
facts.quote: Most couples plan over twelve to eighteen months. Set the budget and start the guest list in the first month, book the venue and key vendors by month three, launch the website when save-the-dates go out, and move to seating, menu and the run sheet in the last six weeks.
facts.publisher: Wedded Wonderland (Free Wedding Planning Tools for Couples)
facts.use_note: Coordinator-requested line, verbatim. See conflict on 'when' vs 'before'.

facts.claim: Studio website builder: publish a shareable site with a built-in RSVP form, track responses and page views; guests RSVP from the public link without an account. Guest list: RSVP status, meal preferences, dietary notes, travel details; invite guests by email, let them self-register, import or export CSV.
facts.quote: The website builder lets you publish a shareable wedding website [...] and a built-in RSVP form [...] then track responses and page views from a single dashboard. Guests can RSVP straight from your public link without creating an account. ... The guest list manager keeps every invitee in one place [...] with RSVP status, meal preferences, dietary notes and travel details. You can invite guests by email, let them self-register, and import or export the whole list as a CSV.
facts.publisher: Wedded Wonderland (Free Wedding Planning Tools for Couples)
facts.use_note: Ellipses [...] mark em dash asides removed. 'Invite guests by email' is a guest list feature, not a save-the-date maker: do not present it as one.

facts.claim: Wedding website examples page FAQ: launch the website before the save-the-dates go out, so the link can go on the card.
facts.quote: Launch your wedding website before the save-the-dates go out, so the link can go on the card.
facts.publisher: Wedded Wonderland (25 Wedding Website Examples)
facts.use_note: Quote taken from the search-result snippet of the live page (Firecrawl search, 26 Nov 2026); the scraped body was truncated before the FAQ. Re-check verbatim before publishing. Page published 24 Oct 2026, modified 26 Oct 2026.

facts.claim: Smartraveller: allow at least 6 weeks to get your passport; where possible, don't book flights without a valid passport.
facts.quote: Allow at least 6 weeks to get your passport. Child applications can sometimes take longer. Where possible, don't book flights without a valid passport.
facts.publisher: Smartraveller (Australian Government, DFAT)

facts.claim: Smartraveller: some countries won't let you enter unless your passport is valid for six months after you plan to leave; some airlines impose this too; can apply in transit; getting it wrong can mean being stranded. Final tip: check your passport is valid for at least six months from the date you will depart your destination, and apply early.
facts.quote: Some countries won't let you enter unless your passport is valid for six months after you plan to leave that country. Some airlines also impose this rule on their own initiative. It can apply even if you're just transiting or stopping over. ... Getting it wrong can mean being stranded. ... check that your passport is valid for at least six months from the date you will depart your destination - apply for a passport early, if you don't already have one
facts.publisher: Smartraveller (Australian Government, DFAT)
facts.use_note: Say 'some countries', not 'many'. Authority confirming: each destination's embassy or consulate and Smartraveller destination pages. Article angle: a line on the save the date or website prompting guests to check passport expiry.

facts.claim: Australian Passport Office (as at October 2026): above 97% of travel documents available within 6 weeks; allow at least 6 weeks from lodging; routine service up to 6 weeks; Fast Track up to 14 business days (standard fee + $107); Priority up to 11 business days (standard fee + $308); faster processing does not guarantee the timeframe for all applications.
facts.quote: Passport timeframes as at October 2026 TRAVEL DOCUMENTS AVAILABLE WITHIN 6 WEEKS* Above 97% ... Allow at least 6 weeks from lodging your application to get your passport. ... Fast Track service [...] up to 14 business days Cost: Standard passport fee + $107 ... Priority service [...] up to 11 business days Cost: Standard passport fee + $308 ... Paying for faster processing doesn't guarantee your application will be processed within the Priority or Fast Track timeframe.
facts.publisher: Australian Passport Office (DFAT)
facts.use_note: Fees are AUD government fees, not our prices; quote as 'AUD107' and 'AUD308' extra on top of the standard fee if used at all. The source text uses an em dash between service name and timeframe; do not reproduce it in the article. Simplest article line: 'allow at least six weeks' (both Smartraveller and APO agree).

facts.claim: OAIC: no page checked speaks to private individuals sharing guests' personal information for a wedding; the Privacy Act generally applies to organisations and agencies, not individuals acting in a personal capacity. No legal privacy claim applies to couples in this article.
facts.quote: Not quoted: no OAIC source read in this pass.
facts.publisher: Office of the Australian Information Commissioner
facts.use_note: Per run-log decision, privacy is advice only (e.g. use BCC or individual sends, check each platform's privacy policy). Make NO legal claim about couples' obligations. Riley & Grey's own page says it does not sell user information to third parties (platform claim, attribute if used).

conflicts.topic: Platform timing for destination save the dates
conflicts.detail: Greenvelope: 8 to 12 months for destination. Evite wedding page: 8 to 12 months generally, earlier for destination. Evite blog snippet: 6 to 8 months. Use our own WW guidance instead.
Greetings Island says four to six months' notice, plus a month for destination weddings: much shorter than Greenvelope, Evite and Bliss & Bone (8 to 12 months destination). Do not cite.

Studio page: 'Free accounts can hold a generous guest list' (no number). /expert-advice/wedding-rsvp snippet (map, not re-read): 'free RSVP and guest list tools do this for up to 50 guests'. Do not state a cap; Nic to confirm.

conflicts.topic: When to launch the wedding website relative to save the dates
conflicts.detail: /wedding-planning-tools says 'launch the website when save-the-dates go out'; /expert-advice/when-to-send-wedding-invitations says 'Have the wedding website live first, since the card points to it'; /destination-weddings/wedding-website-examples says 'before the save-the-dates go out'. Two of three say before. Recommend the article says live before you send (the link goes on the save the date) and, if quoting the tools page, frame it as 'by the time'. Consider aligning the tools page wording (Nic).
